meta.planned_pr_title: feat(explore): 弾は誰にでも当たる
operating_rules: Product owner 神宮 decides every fine gameplay or visual spec. Agents decide only internal technical details (data layout, function names, algorithms).
If something is not covered here, ask 神宮 before implementing it: one question at a time, with options (A/B/C) and a recommendation with a short reason.
Use the term 「帰還」. Never use 「抽出」.
CI (build-and-test) must be green before merge.
After merge, the 'Deploy Modules Preview' workflow run on main must succeed.
Add selftests (packages/explore/src/*.selftest.ts, registered in package.json 'selftest' and excluded in tsconfig.json like the existing ones).
Keep checkpoint (mid-sortie save) and HUB save compatibility: old saves must load; add a compatibility test.
Do not change existing test expectations just to make them pass; any changed assertion must be justified by a decision below.
Minus sign in displayed numbers is U+2212 (−), never ASCII hyphen-minus.

current_behavior.summary_ja: 今は、味方の弾は敵にしか当たらず、敵の弾は味方と他の敵に当たる。障害物・残骸・コンテナ・置き去りの機体は素通り。カバーは命中後のサイコロで外れにする。弾はすべて狙いどおり飛ぶ。

facts.text: A unit fires only when the target is inside the 3° fire arc (half 1.5°) and within range. Base range = BALANCE.weaponRange 160, multiplied by rangeMul (circuits); enemies use 160 × (1 + escort_range rate); MMR uses 160 × range × 3 × (1 + r).

Projectile flies straight along the muzzle direction (unit heading + angle offset) at bulletSpeed 320 for bulletTtlSec 1.2 s ≈ 384 world units, then disappears. Speed is multiplied by speedMul (fast_round 1.5, homing 0.75) and abilityOf().bulletSpeed, so actual travel varies. Homing bends toward its target.
A projectile stops at the first unit it hits (hit radius = target.radius + bulletHitPadding 4).
Ally (leader/wingman) projectiles collide only with enemies. No friendly fire.
Enemy projectiles collide with allies and with other enemies (not the shooter). Matches CIRCUIT_SQUAD_DESIGN_V0.md §11.4 (敵どうしもお互いに敵).

Wrecks, containers, obstacles/cover objects (getCoverObjects) and left-behind mechs/dropped circuits (strandedMechs/strandedDrops) are not collision targets; projectiles pass through them. Only alive units in the target list are checked.

Cover is a post-hit dice roll: on contact, shotHitChance(shooter, target) is computed and the shot misses if Math.random() >= chance. Target in cover: ×coverIncomingHitMul 0.70 (or circuitIncomingMul: 1 − DR, DR = COVER_DR_BASE 0.3 + circuit DR, capped COVER_DR_CAP 0.6, in circuit-play rules). Shooter in cover: ×coverAccuracyMul 1.10 (clamped to 1). A miss logs 「<name> がカバーで回避」 when off-camera.
Separate from cover: units with the dodge circuit may sidestep a projectile on contact (tryDodge), with a cooldown. Applies to enemies hit by ally shots and to allies hit by enemy shots.
Allied AI does not check for allies in the line of fire. No friendly-fire risk evaluation exists.

All projectiles are 100% accurate along the muzzle line (no random spread). Shotgun fires 5 pellets in a fixed fan at −10°, −5°, 0°, +5°, +10°. SMG fires bursts (SMG_CYCLE) without spread; LMG and MMR have no spread.

bulletDamage 10 × attackMul for allies, enemyDamage 5 × enemyDamageMultiplier for enemies (circuit guns: × damageMul, shotgun/SMG pellets 1/4 × (1 + r)). Enemy hits on allies apply campDamageTakenMul and increment world.combatHitsTaken. Enemy targets divide damage by enemyArmorMultiplier.
Kill report: 「戦報: <killer> が <target> を撃破」 where killer is 「敵」 for enemy shots or the ally's name. Non-lethal off-camera hit: 「<target> が被弾 (−n)」 (U+2212 already used).
Overhead combat text exists for resupply only: combatFeedback kinds 'empty' | 'ammo' | 'power', kept in a WeakMap (not saved in checkpoints), drawn in render.ts.
Melee (circuit) damages directly without a projectile; out of scope for this feature.

decisions.ja: 誤射のダメージは通常どおり 100%。
decisions.en: Friendly fire deals 100% of normal damage.

decisions.ja: 敵の弾は今までどおり他の敵にも当たる。
decisions.en: Enemy shots keep hitting other enemies.

decisions.ja: 残骸は弾を素通りさせる（弾を止めるのは後の残骸盾 PR）。
decisions.en: Wrecks let shots pass through (stopping shots belongs to the later wreck-shield PR).

decisions.ja: コンテナは弾を素通りさせる。
障害物は弾を止める（見えないものの向こうは撃てない）。
decisions.en: Obstacles stop shots (you cannot shoot through what you cannot see).

decisions.ja: 弾は最初に当たったもので止まる（貫通は将来の貫通弾だけ）。
decisions.en: A shot stops at the first thing it hits (penetration only for the future penetrating round).

decisions.ja: 外れた弾は約 384 まで飛び続け、途中の誰にでも当たる。
decisions.en: Missed shots keep flying (~384) and hit anything along the way.

decisions.ja: カバーのサイコロをやめる。カバー中は当たり判定の体を小さくする。どれだけ小さくするかは実装者が今の効果に近くなるよう決め、神宮に報告する。
decisions.en: Remove the cover dice roll. While in cover the unit's hit body is smaller; the implementer picks the amount to approximate the current effect and reports it to 神宮.
implementer_decides: cover hit-body shrink amount (report value and reasoning to 神宮)

decisions.ja: 味方の AI は、誤射の危険が大きければ撃たずに横へ動いて射線を空ける。危険が小さければ撃つ（§4）。
decisions.en: Allied AI: if friendly-fire risk is high, hold fire and sidestep to clear the line; if risk is small, fire (EXPLORE_FACING_AIM_V0.md §4).
decisions.note: The exact risk threshold is a fine spec: propose options to 神宮.

decisions.ja: 敵は他の敵を避けない。
decisions.en: Enemies do not avoid other enemies in their line of fire.

decisions.ja: 当たった機体の頭上に「誤射」と出す。
decisions.en: Show overhead text 「誤射」 on the unit that was hit.

decisions.ja: 戦術ログに誤射 1 回につき 1 行：「誤射：<撃った機体> → <当たった機体>（−n）」。マイナスは U+2212。
decisions.en: Tactics log: one line per friendly-fire event 「誤射：<shooter> → <hit unit>（−n）」 using U+2212 minus.

decisions.ja: 誤射でも大破する。戦報は「○○ の誤射で △△ 大破」。
decisions.en: Friendly fire can destroy a unit. Battle report 「○○ の誤射で △△ 大破」.

decisions.ja: 戦闘ごとに誤射の回数を記録する（データ構造を用意）。戦後の分析・精算のあとも残すかは未決定（後で神宮に聞く）。
decisions.en: Record the friendly-fire count per battle (add the data structure). Whether it persists after post-battle analysis/settlement is UNDECIDED; ask 神宮 later.

decisions.ja: 武器の種類ごとにランダムなばらつきを入れる（今はすべて 100% 狙いどおり）。初期値で、遊んでから調整する。特殊弾（高速・誘導・EMP）は武器の種類ではなく、どの武器にも重ねがけされる。
decisions.en: Add per-weapon-type random spread (currently all shots are 100% accurate). Starting values, tuned after playtesting. Special rounds (fast/homing/EMP) are not weapon types and stack on any weapon.

values.weapon: normal (AR, default gun / no gun circuit)

values.spread_deg: 5 pellets, each random (not evenly spaced) within ±2°, replacing the fixed −10/−5/0/+5/+10 fan

decisions.note: 神宮 explicitly confirmed the shotgun option with ±2° random. The other values were proposed by Grok Bot and not objected to; reconfirm them in the PR's question list to 神宮.

decisions.ja: 積載中の生きた僚機（運ぶ機体の位置に乗り、自分の武器で砲台として撃ち続ける。circuitPlay.ts の pickupSpots / placeCarried）と、それを運ぶ機体との間では誤射しない。乗っている僚機の弾は運ぶ機体に当たらず、運ぶ機体の弾も乗っている僚機に当たらない。外から重なった 2 機に当たる弾は、乗っている僚機ではなく運ぶ機体に当たる。
decisions.en: Living wingmen loaded onto a carrier (they ride at the carrier's position and keep firing their own weapon as a turret; see circuitPlay.ts pickupSpots / placeCarried): no friendly fire between a passenger and its carrier — passenger shots never hit its carrier and carrier shots never hit its passenger. Shots from outside that would hit the stacked pair hit the carrier, not the passenger.

future_ideas.ja: 障害物を貫通する回路
future_ideas.en: Circuit that lets shots penetrate obstacles

future_ideas_note: Requested by 神宮 for later. NOT part of this PR.

open_questions.ja: 戦闘ごとの誤射回数を、戦後の分析・精算のあとも残すか。
open_questions.en: Should the per-battle friendly-fire count persist after post-battle analysis/settlement?

open_questions.ja: Q9 の「危険が大きい」の線引き（射線上の味方との距離・半径など）。
Q14 の通常・SMG・MMR・LMG の初期値の再確認。
open_questions.en: Reconfirm Q14 starting spread values for normal/SMG/MMR/LMG.

open_questions.ja: ここに書かれていない細部を見つけたら、実装前に神宮に聞く（選択肢とおすすめ付きで 1 問ずつ）。
open_questions.en: Any uncovered detail must be asked to 神宮 before implementing (one question at a time, options + recommendation).

acceptance_criteria: Ally projectiles hit allies (leader and wingmen, not the shooter) with 100% normal damage (Q1).
Enemy projectiles still hit allies and other enemies (Q2).
Projectiles pass through wrecks, containers, and left-behind mechs/dropped circuits (Q3, Q4).
Projectiles are stopped by obstacles/cover objects (Q5).
A projectile stops at the first unit or obstacle it hits (Q6).
A missed projectile keeps flying until its ttl (~384 at base speed) and can hit any unit along the way (Q7).
The cover dice roll (shotHitChance random miss) is removed; units in cover have a smaller hit body; the chosen value is reported to 神宮 (Q8).
Allied AI holds fire and sidesteps when friendly-fire risk is high, fires when small (Q9).
Enemies do not avoid other enemies (Q10).
Overhead text 「誤射」 appears on a unit hit by friendly fire (Q11).
Tactics log line 「誤射：<撃った機体> → <当たった機体>（−n）」 once per friendly-fire event, U+2212 minus (Q12).
Friendly fire can destroy; battle report 「○○ の誤射で △△ 大破」 (Q13).
Per-battle friendly-fire count is recorded (Q11b); persistence beyond settlement is not decided.
Per-weapon random spread with the Q14 starting values; shotgun pellets random within ±2°; special rounds stack on any weapon (Q14).
A passenger (living wingman carried as a turret) and its carrier never hit each other with their shots; outside shots that reach the stacked pair hit the carrier, not the passenger (Q15).
Selftests cover each item above, including a deterministic RNG for spread tests.
Checkpoint compatibility: an old mid-sortie save (bullets without new fields, no friendly-fire count) loads and plays; HUB save unchanged unless 神宮 decides otherwise.
Docs updated: docs/EXPLORE_FACING_AIM_V0.md §3 (命中) and §4 (誤射), docs/STATUS.md.
CI green, squash merge, Deploy Modules Preview succeeds.

verification_notes.text: Confirmed 320 × 1.2 s = 384 at base speed. Actual distance varies with speedMul (fast_round 1.5 → ~576, homing 0.75 → ~288) and abilityOf().bulletSpeed.

MMR fire range is 160 × range × 3 × (1 + r) ≥ 480, longer than the ~384 a base-speed projectile travels. MMR shots at long range can vanish before reaching the target today. Not addressed by the decisions; ask 神宮 if it matters.
Enemy range is 160 × (1 + escort_range rate), not a flat 160.

The cover dice also includes the shooter-in-cover factor coverAccuracyMul 1.10 (clamped to 1, so it has no effect today) and the circuit DR path (circuitIncomingMul). Q8 replaces all of it with a smaller hit body.
A separate dodge circuit mechanic (tryDodge) exists on contact. Not covered by the decisions; keep it unless 神宮 says otherwise.
docs/EXPLORE_FACING_AIM_V0.md §3 says 「敵の弾は味方にしか当たらない今のコードは直す」, but the current code already lets enemy shots hit other enemies. Only ally shots lack friendly fire. Fix the doc sentence in this PR.

MECH_WORLD_BUILDING_DESIGN.md has §1-§7 only. §4 there is 機体の向き・視界・射撃 (friendly fire as risk-based judgment), and §3 is cargo/containers. §11.4 is in docs/CIRCUIT_SQUAD_DESIGN_V0.md (enemy spec, enemies are hostile to each other). The detailed 命中/誤射 rules are in docs/EXPLORE_FACING_AIM_V0.md §3/§4.
combatFeedback is a WeakMap, not saved in checkpoints. A 「誤射」 overhead text would also be lost on resume, which is fine for transient text.
Carried wingmen stay in world.wingmen and ride on their carrier (placeCarried). Resolved by Q15: no friendly fire between passenger and carrier; outside shots hit the carrier.
User chose boundary cover and explicitly prohibited obstacle penetration. Remove attraction/snapping and enforce swept movement collision.

owner_addendum_2026_10_17.spread: Explicitly confirmed normal ±2°, SMG ±5°, MMR ±0.5°, LMG ±4°; shotgun unchanged from Q14.
owner_addendum_2026_10_17.risk: Hold fire and sidestep when the unscattered muzzle line intersects an ally before the intended enemy. Spread-only risk does not prohibit fire.
owner_addendum_2026_10_17.learning: Count friendly-fire hits privately per battle and retain after settlement for future learning. No count display or reward penalty.
owner_addendum_2026_10_17.mmr: Keep bullet speed; lifetime gives 1.3 × effective MMR range, including final speed of special ammo.
owner_addendum_2026_10_17.cover: Override center snapping: no suction; cover at the obstacle boundary; units cannot enter or pass through obstacles, accounting for body radius. Keep reduced hit body.
